prompt_header:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original 2D ANIME character-in-scene atlas.
Canvas: LANDSCAPE 3:2, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, FOUR independent landscape scenes in a precise 2x2 grid. Thin continuous dark divider lines exactly at horizontal and vertical midpoints. No gutters. Each scene and its small exact ID label fit inside its own panel.
Art direction: unmistakable polished Japanese-anime / anime-game promotional illustration, beautiful hand-drawn 2D linework, crisp graceful contours, clean CEL SHADING with a few deliberate shadow shapes, luminous harmonious colors. Appealing expressive anime faces with large carefully drawn eyes, small simplified noses and chins, elegant hair silhouettes. Entire cast has slender, balanced, healthy stylized anime proportions and clear slim silhouettes, with naturally proportioned limbs and hands. Vary hairstyles, hair colors, expressions and clothing between scenes. Background extras use the same slender anime character design. No photorealism, no semi-realistic mature portrait faces, no live-action look, no realistic skin pores, no 3D render, no heavy impasto, no chibi.
Age and context: follow EACH panel's specified ages. Middle/high-school students must look like ordinary 13-17-year-old adolescents in complete modest school or PE uniforms, with age-appropriate faces and anatomy; teachers and other adult roles must clearly remain adults. Outside school/student scenes, the prominent women are adults aged about 20-35. All scenes are everyday, occupational, narrative or fantasy reference illustrations, never pin-ups, erotic poses or body-part displays.
Scene design: each panel has at least one prominent female character around 50-75 percent of panel height, full-body or medium-wide as suited to the activity. Both the place AND the person's activity must be clear. Attractive carefully composed anime backgrounds with foreground, middle ground and depth; architecture, environment landmarks, perspective and light remain coherent. Characters actually hold and touch relevant props; feet, chairs and objects have proper support. Preserve the complete intended action and key setting details. No isolated fashion cutouts, empty rooms, generic gradients, inset panels, unreadable hands, cropped heads or feet where a full figure is intended.
Only each panel's exact ID in small legible text at its own top-left. No other readable text, brands, real school/company names, logos, celebrity likenesses, existing anime characters or franchise symbols.

categories.name: 居家生活场景
entries: 厨房备餐场景
kitchen food-preparation scene
橱柜、灶台、冰箱与操作台构成家庭厨房，穿围裙的女性正在台面整理蔬菜。
看清人物手部与台面、食材的接触，操作区、灶台和后方窗口分层。

A sunlit residential kitchen with stove, sink, refrigerator and cabinets; an adult woman wearing a cotton shirt and apron sorts vegetables on a wooden chopping board at the counter. Clearly show her hands touching the vegetables, countertop depth and the usable aisle.
卧室整理床铺场景
bedroom bed-making scene
床、床头柜、衣柜与晨光窗口形成卧室，穿完整家居服的女性整理被褥。
让床体尺度、人物动作与卧室动线共同说明用途，避免只剩床边人像。

A cozy bedroom with a bed, bedside table, wardrobe and morning window; an adult woman in a fully opaque modest pajama set spreads a folded quilt across the bed. Her hands visibly lift the fabric and her body is grounded beside the mattress.
客厅读书场景
living-room reading scene
沙发、茶几、书架与地毯形成客厅，女性坐在沙发上读书，桌面有茶杯。
以坐姿与沙发承托关系明确休闲活动，保留客厅前后空间。

A warm lived-in living room with sofa, coffee table, rug and bookshelves; an adult woman in casual knitwear sits comfortably on the sofa reading an open book, a tea cup on the table. Show the seated body support and furniture arrangement.
浴室洗漱场景
bathroom morning-routine scene
洗手台、镜面、浴缸与毛巾架构成浴室，穿完整睡衣的女性在台前刷牙。
镜中反射与人物位置一致，手、牙刷和水台接触清楚，画面重点为洗漱空间。

A clean residential bathroom with basin, mirror, bathtub and towel rail; an adult woman in a fully opaque long-sleeved pajama set brushes her teeth at the basin. No bathing or undressing. A limited physically consistent mirror reflection, clearly visible bathroom fixtures and a dry floor.
书房写作场景
home-study writing scene
书桌、台灯、书架与窗边工作区构成书房，女性坐在桌前敲键盘并查看笔记。
让键盘、座椅与手臂高度合理，以书房布置表达安静专注。

A home study with desk, task lamp, bookshelves and window; an adult woman with glasses sits at a laptop typing while consulting a notebook. Her forearms align with the desk, feet grounded, and the room layout remains visible.
阳台养花场景
balcony plant-care scene
栏杆、花架、盆栽与城市远景构成阳台，女性手持浇水壶照料植物。
人物与花盆的操作距离清楚，栏杆与建筑远景提供空间层次。

An urban apartment balcony with railings, tiered plant shelves, flowering pots and a distant city view; an adult woman in a casual blouse waters a pot with a small watering can. Show the hand on the handle and water directed at soil, full grounded stance.
洗衣间整理衣物场景
laundry-room sorting scene
洗衣机、晾衣架、收纳柜与衣篮构成洗衣区，女性把叠好的毛巾放入篮中。
区分柜体、机器与衣篮的层次，衣物应真正落在人物手中。

A compact laundry room with washing machine, drying rack, shelves and laundry baskets; an adult woman in comfortable everyday clothes puts a folded stack of towels into a basket. The basket and appliance openings are clearly distinct, natural hand contacts.
玄关出门准备场景
entryway departure-preparation scene
鞋柜、穿衣镜、衣帽钩与门口地垫构成玄关，女性穿好外套并取下挂钩上的挎包。
通过门、鞋凳与挂钩关系呈现出门动线，包带与手部连接真实。

A residential entryway with shoe cabinet, bench, coat hooks, standing mirror and front door; an adult woman already dressed in an outdoor jacket reaches for a shoulder bag hanging on a hook. Show the door threshold, bag strap contact and plausible circulation space.

categories.name: 工作与公共空间
entries: 办公室协作场景
office collaboration scene
办公桌、电脑、文件柜与玻璃隔断构成办公室，女性职员拿平板与同事讨论。
人物应处于真实工作动线中，桌椅、屏幕和协作姿态共同表达办公场景。

A modern shared office with desks, monitors, filing cabinets and glass partitions; an adult female professional in business-casual clothing stands beside a colleague's desk holding a tablet and discussing work. The main woman is prominent; coworkers secondary, generic unreadable screens.
会议室汇报场景
meeting-room presentation scene
长会议桌、座椅、投影屏与白板构成会议室，女性在屏幕旁向几位成年同事讲解。
汇报者、听众视线与屏幕方向一致，桌面透视保持连续。

A meeting room with long table, chairs, projection screen and whiteboard; an adult woman in a blazer presents simple abstract charts to two seated adult colleagues. Clear presenter-to-audience eye lines, consistent table perspective, no legible real company text.
医院门诊交流场景
hospital consultation scene
诊室中的问诊桌、检查床与医疗柜形成医院门诊，穿白大褂的女医生与成年女患者交流。
医生与就诊者的位置、视线及桌面交流关系清楚，设备仅作环境识别。

A bright hospital consultation room with clinician's desk, examination couch, medical cabinet and handwashing basin; an adult female doctor in a white coat calmly speaks with an adult female patient seated across the desk. No procedure, injury, readable patient data or medical instructions. The doctor is the main figure.
实验室观察场景
laboratory observation scene
实验台、显微镜、封闭样本盒与柜体构成研究室，穿实验服的女研究员观察样本。
保留台面高度、显微镜与人物姿态的接触关系，不把道具堆成无用途背景。

A contemporary research laboratory with workbench, microscope, sealed specimen containers and storage cabinets; an adult female researcher in a lab coat and safety glasses observes a sealed benign sample under a microscope. Non-hazardous generic research, no actionable experiment instructions.
中学教室授课场景
secondary-school classroom teaching scene
黑板、投影幕、课桌与讲台形成中学教室，成年女教师授课，穿校服的初高中学生在座位上听讲。
教师、讲台与学生座位的方向明确，人物动作服务于教学空间。

An ordinary secondary-school classroom: blackboard, projector screen, lectern and rows of desks. An adult female teacher aged about 28 explains a simple abstract diagram; 14-16-year-old middle/high-school students in modest complete school uniforms listen at desks. Make the teacher prominent and clearly adult and the students clearly adolescent, no university lecture-hall styling.
图书馆阅览场景
library reading scene
高书架、阅览桌与大窗构成图书馆，女性在桌边翻阅书籍，书架间还有成年读者。
人物、桌面与书架透视共同形成安静的公共阅览空间。

A spacious public library with tall bookshelves, reading tables, warm lamps and large windows; an adult woman in a cardigan turns a page of an open book at a reading table. One distant adult reader between shelves, strong foreground-to-background depth.
地铁站通勤场景
metro-station commuting scene
站台、闸机、候车线与列车形成地铁空间，女性通勤者提包在安全区域候车。
车门、站台与人物比例一致，站姿与行李位置留出公共通道。

A contemporary metro station platform with train doors, safety line, turnstiles in the distance and simplified route signage; an adult female commuter in everyday work clothes stands safely behind the line holding her bag. Clear platform depth, main figure large, signage abstract and unreadable.
消防站备勤场景
fire-station readiness scene
车库、消防车、装备柜与长凳构成消防站，女消防员在车辆旁检查头盔与外套。
体现人物与装备柜、车辆的尺度关系，呈现备勤而非灾难现场。

An original unbranded fire station garage with a fire engine, gear lockers and bench; an adult female firefighter in practical trousers and work shirt checks her helmet beside her protective coat. Calm readiness scene, no emergency, no specific insignia or real department logo.

categories.name: 餐饮住宿与商业场景
entries: 酒店大堂接待场景
hotel-lobby reception scene
前台、休息座椅、行李与电梯入口构成酒店大堂，女接待员迎接成年旅客。
前台内外的站位及行李尺度明确，接待动作要与空间用途一致。

An elegant unbranded hotel lobby with reception desk, seating area, luggage and elevator entrance; an adult female receptionist greets an adult traveler with a rolling suitcase. The receptionist is prominent and the spatial separation across the desk is clear.
酒店客房入住场景
hotel-room arrival scene
整洁床铺、行李架、桌椅与城市窗口形成酒店客房，穿便装的女旅客打开行李箱。
用行李架、标准化家具和入住动作区别酒店客房与家庭卧室。

A modern hotel guest room with made bed, luggage stand, desk, chair and city-view window; an adult female traveler in fully clothed casual travel wear opens a suitcase on the luggage stand. Show room furnishings and the arrival activity, not a fashion portrait.
餐厅桌边服务场景
restaurant table-service scene
餐桌、餐椅、灯具与备餐区构成餐厅，女服务员把餐盘放到桌边。
托盘、手臂与餐桌接触可信，留出服务通道与客席层次。

A welcoming restaurant dining room with set tables, chairs, pendant lights and service station; an adult female server in a simple apron carefully places a plate on a table for adult diners. Keep server hands, plate and table contact readable, no brand labels.
咖啡馆吧台场景
cafe barista-at-counter scene
咖啡机、吧台、杯架与靠窗座位构成咖啡馆，女咖啡师在吧台准备饮品。
人物、杯具和咖啡机形成操作关系，背景座位与窗光说明店铺空间。

A cozy cafe with espresso machine, service counter, cup shelves and window seating; an adult female barista in an apron prepares a cup at the machine. Main figure prominent behind the counter, a few seating tables visible, hands clearly holding the cup and pitcher.
面包店出炉陈列场景
bakery bread-display scene
面包陈列架、玻璃柜与烤箱构成面包店，女面包师把烤盘放到陈列区。
烤盘需有清楚握持点，商品陈列与后场烤箱分区可辨。

A neighborhood bakery with bread shelves, glass display counter and oven in the rear; an adult female baker in apron and simple cap uses oven mitts to set a tray of bread onto a cooling rack. Distinct retail front and work area, no logos or readable packaging.
超市选购场景
supermarket grocery-shopping scene
货架、购物篮、蔬果区与通道构成超市，女性在货架旁查看商品。
人物和购物篮保持真实连接，货架高度与通道宽度可读。

A clean supermarket with grocery shelves, produce displays, baskets and shopping aisles; an adult woman in casual clothes holds a shopping basket while inspecting a generic packaged item. No legible brand labels, main woman large, believable shelf heights and clear aisle perspective.
服装店陈列服务场景
clothing-boutique display scene
衣架、试衣间、模特台与收银区构成服装店，女店员整理人台上的外套。
人台与店员应是两个独立主体，衣物悬挂与手部操作关系清楚。

A contemporary clothing boutique with clothing racks, fitting-room curtains, display mannequin and checkout desk; an adult female shop assistant adjusts a jacket on the mannequin. Show the mannequin as a distinct object, hands touching the garment, no branded signs.
美发沙龙造型场景
hair-salon styling scene
镜面、理发椅、工具车与洗发区构成沙龙，女造型师为成年顾客梳理头发。
镜中反射、顾客坐姿与造型师站位保持一致，工具不悬空。

A bright hair salon with styling mirrors, salon chair, tool trolley and shampoo station; an adult female stylist combs the hair of a seated adult female client. Main stylist clearly visible, physically consistent partial reflection and natural comb-to-hair contact, no sharp-tool close-up.

categories.name: 休闲自然与旅行场景
entries: 沙滩漫步场景
beach-walking scene
海浪、沙岸、遮阳伞与远处栈道形成沙滩，穿轻便夏装的女性沿海岸漫步。
人物脚步与湿沙接触，海岸曲线和地平线提供空间尺度。

A sunny beach with gentle surf, sandy shore, beach umbrellas and a distant boardwalk; an adult woman in a light summer dress and sunhat walks barefoot along the waterline carrying her sandals. Full grounded figure, footprints and shoreline depth, no fashion pin-up framing.
游乐园游玩场景
amusement-park outing scene
摩天轮、旋转木马、票亭与步道构成游乐园，成年女性手拿地图与饮品游览。
人物不应被巨大游乐设施淹没，前景活动和后方设施都可辨认。

A cheerful original amusement park with Ferris wheel, generic carousel, ticket booth and pedestrian path; an adult woman in colorful casual clothing holds a park map and a drink while looking toward a ride. All supporting visitors adults, no recognizable franchise mascots.
露营地整理装备场景
campsite gear-preparation scene
帐篷、折叠椅、营地桌与林地形成露营地，女性把装备放到营地桌上。
帐篷、桌椅与人物尺度一致，用整理装备的活动说明露营用途。

A peaceful forest campsite with tent, folding chairs, camping table and backpacks; an adult female camper in outdoor clothes organizes a water flask and folded blanket on the table. No active fire or risky camping instruction; main figure large, trees and campsite layout visible.
城市公园慢跑场景
urban-park jogging scene
绿道、草坪、湖岸与公园长凳构成城市公园，女性沿路径慢跑。
脚步落点与道路方向明确，保留运动者与公园设施的空间关系。

An urban park with jogging path, lawns, lakeside railings and benches; an adult woman in ordinary athletic clothing jogs naturally along the path. Full body grounded mid-stride, relaxed posture, park surroundings clearly identifiable.
温泉旅馆回廊场景
hot-spring-inn corridor scene
木质回廊、庭院、纸灯与浴场入口构成温泉旅馆，穿完整浴衣的女性提着毛巾篮经过。
以回廊和庭院表现旅馆氛围，人物保持完整着装并融入行走动线。

A tranquil hot-spring inn wooden corridor with courtyard garden, paper lanterns and a bathhouse entrance in the distance; an adult woman in a fully closed opaque yukata walks carrying a small towel basket. No bathing or nudity, calm architectural atmosphere, clear figure-to-floor contact.
山间步道徒步场景
mountain-trail hiking scene
山径、岩石、植被与远山形成徒步环境，背包女性沿步道前行。
人物和背包保持合理重心，近景岩石、中景山径与远景山体分层。

A scenic mountain hiking trail with rocks, vegetation, trail markers and distant peaks; an adult female hiker wearing boots and a daypack walks on a safe broad section of the path holding trekking poles. Clear footing and scale, expansive landscape without shrinking the main figure.
滑雪场整装场景
ski-resort preparation scene
雪道、缆车、雪具架与山间服务站构成滑雪场，女性在缓坡旁整理滑雪装备。
雪具与手部、雪地的支撑关系清楚，呈现出发前的环境与人物。

A winter ski resort with gentle snow slope, lift, ski racks and lodge; an adult woman in a colorful ski jacket, snow trousers and helmet stands beside the rack holding skis upright. Preparation on stable snow, no stunt, main figure prominent against the snowy environment.
机场候机场景
airport departure-lounge scene
登机口、候机椅、落地窗与远处飞机构成机场，女性旅客拉着行李箱查看登机信息。
行李、人物与候机座椅尺度统一，航站楼结构和窗外飞机共同说明地点。

An airport departure lounge with gate desk, rows of seats, large windows and an airplane outside; an adult female traveler in a travel jacket pulls a rolling suitcase while checking a generic boarding display. No real airline branding or readable personal information.

categories.name: 文体演出与节庆场景
entries: 健身房训练场景
gym workout scene
训练器械、地垫、镜墙与储物区构成健身房，女性在器械旁进行轻度热身。
以器械布局与人物完整姿态说明训练空间，镜中反射保持合理。

A modern gym with exercise machines, floor mats, a partial mirror wall and lockers; an adult woman in an opaque athletic top and leggings performs a gentle standing warm-up beside a mat. Full-body view, realistic gym layout, not a bodybuilding or pin-up close-up.
游泳馆池畔场景
indoor-pool poolside scene
泳道、水面、池梯与观众座椅构成室内游泳馆，成年女性在池畔准备下水。
人物与池沿保持清楚距离，泳道和建筑结构共同界定场景。

A bright indoor swimming pool with lane ropes, pool ladder, tiled deck and seating; an adult woman in an ordinary opaque one-piece sports swimsuit stands on the deck holding a towel, preparing for a swim. Neutral athletic presentation, full contextual framing, no body-part emphasis.
舞蹈排练室练习场景
dance-studio rehearsal scene
把杆、镜面、木地板与音响构成排练室，女性在把杆旁进行舞蹈练习。
人物、把杆与地面支撑清楚，镜像保持一致，动作服务于场景识别。

A dance rehearsal studio with barre, mirror wall, sprung wooden floor and speaker; an adult female dancer in an opaque practice top and leggings rehearses a simple standing position at the barre. Whole figure and feet visible, physically consistent partial mirror reflection.
演唱会后台候场场景
concert-backstage preparation scene
化妆镜、服装架、音箱与舞台通道构成后台，女歌手整理外套准备出场。
镜前准备活动与舞台入口相联系，用环境道具区别后台和普通卧室。

An original concert backstage dressing area with lit makeup mirror, garment rack, equipment cases and a passage toward stage lights; an adult female singer in an opaque stage jacket adjusts her collar before going onstage. Clear practical dressing activity, no celebrity resemblance or logos.
剧院舞台表演场景
theatre-stage performance scene
幕布、舞台布景、脚灯与观众席构成剧院，女演员在布景前进行表演。
表演者与舞台地板、布景尺度一致，灯光引导观众注意人物动作。

A theatre stage with curtains, original painted set, footlights and the suggestion of an auditorium; an adult actress in a modest theatrical costume delivers a dramatic open-handed gesture. Whole performer clearly visible, coherent stage perspective and lighting, no known play character.
体育场赛前准备场景
athletics-stadium preparation scene
跑道、看台、起跑区与记分设施构成体育场，女运动员在跑道旁调整跑鞋。
人物、跑道和看台的比例合理，以赛前活动表达场景用途。

An athletics stadium with running track, stands, starting area and abstract scoreboard; an adult female runner in standard athletic clothing bends slightly to adjust a running shoe before a race. Clearly readable sports setting and grounded body, no real team logos.
夜市摊位经营场景
night-market stall scene
摊棚、食物柜、灯串与步行人流构成夜市，女性摊主在摊前递出餐盒。
摊主和顾客的互动清楚，以前景摊位和后景灯光建立热闹层次。

A lively original night market with food stalls, string lights and a pedestrian lane; an adult female stall owner in an apron hands a closed takeaway food box to an adult customer. Generic unbranded stalls, main woman prominent, warm foreground and layered night background.
婚礼会场迎宾场景
wedding-venue greeting scene
花门、座椅、礼台与灯饰构成婚礼会场，成年新娘在入口与来宾致意。
礼服人物与花门、宾客构成仪式空间，避免仅有无背景的婚纱立绘。

An original garden wedding venue with floral arch, guest chairs, ceremony table and soft lights; an adult bride in a modest elegant wedding gown greets adult guests at the entrance holding a small bouquet. Full contextual scene, main bride large and readable, no celebrity resemblance.

categories.name: 历史与影视叙事场景
entries: 古风庭院游赏场景
Chinese-inspired courtyard scene
廊柱、庭院、池石与花木形成古风宅院，穿汉服灵感长衣的女性在回廊停步观景。
观察衣着、人物与院落的尺度关系；画面为原创历史灵感而非考古复原。

An original Chinese-historical-inspired courtyard with wooden colonnade, garden pond, ornamental rocks and flowering trees; an adult woman in a modest flowing hanfu-inspired outfit pauses in the corridor holding a folded fan. Clear architectural setting and full grounded figure, not an exact historical reconstruction.
宫殿殿堂议事场景
palace-hall audience scene

邮局寄件场景
post-office parcel-mailing scene
业务柜台、包裹秤、包装区与等候线构成邮局，女性把包装好的包裹交给工作人员。
包裹、双手与称重台接触合理，单据不出现真实地址或个人信息。

An unbranded neighborhood post office with service counter, parcel scale, packing station and queue area. A prominent adult woman places a sealed parcel on the scale as an adult postal clerk assists her. Show natural two-hand support, no readable addresses, names or postal logos.
银行大厅办理业务场景
bank service-hall scene
业务柜台、叫号座椅、自助设备与隔断构成银行大厅，女性与工作人员在柜台交流。
通过柜台尺度、排队座位与交流姿态识别服务场景，不展示账户内容。

A generic bank service hall with teller counter, queue seating, self-service machines and privacy partitions. A prominent adult female customer in everyday clothes discusses a generic form with an adult female teller. Clear counter relationship, abstract unreadable displays and papers, no bank logos or financial instructions.
菜市场采购场景
fresh-food-market shopping scene
蔬菜摊、称重台、遮棚与通道构成社区菜市场，女性提篮挑选新鲜蔬菜。
人物、食材与摊位的前后关系清楚，体现生鲜市场而非餐饮夜市。

A lively neighborhood fresh-food market with vegetable stalls, produce scales, awnings and an open aisle. A prominent adult woman with a shopping basket selects a bunch of leafy vegetables from an adult vendor. Natural hand-to-produce contact and clear stall depth, no readable brands or price signs.
宠物诊所照料场景
veterinary-clinic care scene
检查台、宠物笼、收纳柜与动物图示形成宠物诊所，女兽医安抚检查台上的猫。
人物与动物有轻柔接触，台面承托与主人站位清楚，不绘制治疗操作。

A calm veterinary clinic with examination table, pet carrier, storage cabinet and original simple animal diagrams. A prominent adult female veterinarian in a coat gently reassures a relaxed cat on the table while its adult owner stands nearby. No injury, procedure or medical instruction, plausible animal anatomy and gentle contact.
社区花店扎花场景
neighborhood florist bouquet-making scene
花桶、包装纸、工作台与橱窗构成花店，女花艺师在桌边为花束系缎带。
手、花束与缎带连接真实，花店工作区与陈列区分开。

A neighborhood florist shop with flower buckets, wrapping paper, workbench and display window. A prominent adult female florist ties a simple ribbon around an original bouquet on the worktable. Clear stem, ribbon and hand contact, colorful flowers and readable shop layout, no brand signage.
高铁候车厅候车场景
high-speed-rail waiting-hall scene
检票闸机、排椅、行李与窗外列车构成高铁候车厅，女性旅客查看车票并等候检票。
人物、行李和闸机比例清楚，以轨道列车线索区别于机场。

A modern high-speed railway waiting hall with ticket gates, seating rows, luggage and a sleek unbranded train visible through a side window. A prominent adult female traveler checks a generic ticket beside her rolling suitcase. No airplane imagery, no readable personal data or railway logos.

categories.name: 文化游览与休闲
entries: 博物馆讲解场景
museum guided-tour scene
展柜、展台、说明牌与高厅形成博物馆，女性讲解员向成年参观者介绍原创展品。
讲解者、展品与参观者的视线有对应，展品不复制具体馆藏。

A museum gallery with display cases, plinths, abstract information panels and a spacious hall. A prominent adult female guide gestures toward an invented ceramic vessel and stone artifact for two adult visitors. Original generic exhibits, no copied museum artwork, no readable institution branding.
美术馆观展场景
art-gallery viewing scene
留白展墙、画框、长凳与轨道灯构成美术馆，女性观众停在原创抽象画前欣赏。
人物视线、画框和灯光关系明确，以展厅纵深保留空间。

A contemporary art gallery with white exhibition walls, framed original abstract paintings, viewing bench and track lights. A prominent adult female visitor stands looking at a large invented abstract canvas, holding a folded gallery leaflet. No recognizable existing artwork or artist signature; clear room depth and eye line.
电影院检票入场场景
cinema ticket-checking scene
影厅入口、检票台、灯箱与走廊构成影院，女工作人员为成年观众检票。
检票接触、入口和厅门位置明确，电影海报只使用原创抽象图形。

An unbranded cinema foyer with screening-room entrance, ticket-check stand, abstract original poster lightboxes and dim corridor. A prominent adult female usher checks a generic ticket held by an adult moviegoer. Natural hand contact, no identifiable film characters, movie posters or readable brands.
海洋馆隧道参观场景
aquarium-tunnel visit scene
透明水下观览隧道、鱼群、蓝色光线与步道形成海洋馆，女性讲解员向成年游客介绍水生动物。
玻璃内外、人物脚下步道与鱼群尺度分开，呈现公共观览而非研究基地。

A public aquarium's glass viewing tunnel with fish overhead, blue water light and a dry pedestrian walkway. A prominent adult female aquarium educator holding a clipboard explains a passing ray to two adult visitors. Clear glass separation and human scale, no underwater laboratory equipment or diving inside.
动物园饲养照料场景
zoo animal-care scene
围栏、兽舍、饲料车与绿地构成动物园，女饲养员在工作通道准备长颈鹿的食物。
人物与动物的尺度、围栏分隔和工具接触清楚，突出日常照料。

A zoo giraffe habitat with protective fence, animal shelter, feeding trolley and greenery. A prominent adult female keeper in practical workwear prepares leafy feed in the staff service aisle while a giraffe stands beyond the barrier. Calm routine care, believable animal scale and safe physical separation, no logos.
植物园温室游览场景
botanical-garden greenhouse visit scene
玻璃穹顶、棕榈、植物标牌与步道构成植物园温室，女性游客用手机记录植物。
让温室结构、植物尺度与摄影动作共同说明游览活动，区别于家庭阳台与异星温室。

A real-world botanical garden greenhouse with glass dome, tall palms, original abstract plant labels and winding visitor paths. A prominent adult female tourist in casual travel clothes photographs a flowering plant with a phone in a solid bright orange protective case. The back of the phone case is completely plain, with no symbol, mark or logo. Clear phone grip, grounded stance, warm natural daylight and no science-fiction elements.
古镇水巷游览场景
canal-town sightseeing scene
石桥、临水民居、小船与沿河街道构成古镇水巷，女性游客沿岸步行观景。
桥、河岸、船与人物比例明确，人物穿当代旅行服装以表现实地游览。

An original contemporary East Asian canal town with a stone footbridge, waterside houses, small moored boats and riverside lane. A prominent adult female tourist in a light travel coat walks along the bank carrying a folded umbrella and admiring the view. Clear bridge and water-level perspective, no copied landmark or historical authenticity claim.
海港码头候船场景
harbor-pier ferry-waiting scene
渡轮泊位、系缆柱、行李与港湾远景构成海港码头，女性旅客在候船区查看船票。
人物站在陆侧候船区域，港口设施与船只的尺度关系可信。

A coastal ferry pier with moored ferry, bollards, waiting shelter, luggage and distant harbor boats. A prominent adult female traveler in a casual windbreaker checks a generic ferry ticket in the landside waiting area. Clear pier edge, boat scale and grounded stance, no readable personal information or shipping logos.
